title: Directed action request, v0
description: What an agent sends to ask a tool to act for a person. contract.md defines the rules; this schema gives the shape.

contract.description: The contract version the request follows.

action.description: What to do. contract.md lists each action's effect class and required fields.

agent.description: The name of the agent that is acting.

identity.description: The account that acts. Required for actions other people can see.

target.description: What the action applies to, and who will see it.

conversation.description: The id of a Teams chat or channel conversation.

message.description: The id of a message: the one replied to, reacted to, or a mail draft.

recipients.description: Everyone the agent expects to see the result.

expected_version.description: The target's version the agent read. The request is refused if the target has changed since.

intent_key.description: A key the agent chooses for one send. A retry with the same key returns the earlier request instead of sending twice. Allowed only on send actions.
